method: bounded read-only source/control-flow audit; no runtime reproduction or numerical validation for residual findings

conditional_public_op_findings.trigger: CUDA/device ops/residency/defer enabled -> step_begin -> z=slice_cols(x,0,C) -> set_device_ops(false) -> op(z); rmsnorm can also receive computed w
conditional_public_op_findings.reason: fallback reads x (and rmsnorm w) without materializing; devops active() returns false after toggle, but setter does not materialize existing values
conditional_public_op_findings.limitation: ordinary active-on valid geometry uses supported device kernels, so missing host materialization is not evidence of default active-on corruption

conditional_public_op_findings.trigger: device-produced z used by op while active -> loss=mean(op(z)) -> set_device_ops(false) -> backward(loss)
conditional_public_op_findings.reason: CPU fallback materializes dy (and rms inverse) but not saved device-fresh x; rmsnorm may additionally read computed w
conditional_public_op_findings.limitation: host-forward branch already materializes x for silu; plain host-fresh leaf inputs do not expose saved-input gap

conditional_public_op_findings.trigger: s=op(x), c constant nonuniform; loss=mean(mul(s,c)) with ops active, then disable ops before backward(loss)
conditional_public_op_findings.reason: GPU mul keeps s output stale; fallback backward materializes dy but reads saved s/self->data without materialization; mean(s) alone hides gap by downloading s
conditional_public_op_findings.limitation: weighted composed graph matters; ordinary mean directly on s may already make s coherent

conditional_public_op_findings.trigger: computed weight w=slice_cols(w0,0,group) left stale, then disable ops before forward or backward
conditional_public_op_findings.reason: group fallback materializes x (and backward inverse/dy), but still reads w raw; public API requires geometry, not leaf weights
conditional_public_op_findings.limitation: normal module leaf weights are host-fresh, so classify as computed-parameter/mode-switch case

coherent_or_explicitly_unsupported.reason: relevant host operands materialized before CPU reads; forward-host paths keep immutable tape inputs coherent into backward
throws explicit device backward unavailable; unsupported transition is not a silent stale host read
want_gm forces step_end before grad_map; packed score closes batch window before consumer; probes explicitly materialize logits
current call paths have no open deferred step; CUDA write-through gives fresh host values, so merely missing macros is insufficient to label corruption
